details.description: Claude Opus 4.1 (claude-opus-4-1-20250805) is Anthropic's incremental upgrade to Claude Opus 4, released August 5, 2025, with improvements to coding, multi-file refactoring, reasoning, and agentic-task performance. It accepts text and image input, supports extended thinking, and Amazon Bedrock's model card lists a March 2025 knowledge cutoff. As of September 2026, Amazon Bedrock's own model card lists the model's lifecycle as Legacy with a stated end-of-life date of January 8, 2027, while Anthropic has already fully retired it on its direct Claude API, effective August 5, 2026.
advantages: Scores 74.5% on SWE-bench Verified, an improvement over Claude Opus 4, per Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1 announcement.
Windsurf reports Opus 4.1 delivers a one-standard-deviation improvement over Opus 4 on its junior-developer coding benchmark, per Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1 announcement.
GitHub reports particularly notable performance gains in multi-file code refactoring with Opus 4.1, per Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1 announcement.
Rakuten Group reports Opus 4.1 excels at pinpointing exact corrections within large codebases without making unnecessary adjustments or introducing bugs, per Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1 announcement.
Notable gains in agentic search and detail-tracking for research and data-analysis workflows, per Anthropic's announcement.
disadvantages: On Amazon Bedrock the model's own model card lists lifecycle status 'Legacy' with an end-of-life date of January 8, 2027; Anthropic has already fully retired the model on its own Claude API, effective August 5, 2026, recommending claude-opus-4-8 as the replacement.
Superseded within Anthropic's Opus line by several newer releases (Opus 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, 5, 5.5) since its August 2025 launch.
use_cases: Complex coding and multi-file refactoring in large, existing codebases
Long-horizon agentic workflows and multi-turn reasoning and planning for complex tasks
Research and data-analysis workflows requiring careful detail tracking
Junior-developer-level coding assistance and code review

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.1 - Amazon Bedrock User Guide
Claude on Amazon Bedrock (Opus 4.6 and earlier) - Claude Platform Docs

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date (2027-01-08) matches Amazon Bedrock's own model card exactly ('Model EOL date: January 8, 2027'), confirming the catalog fact is Bedrock's schedule, not Anthropic's direct-API schedule (which already retired the model August 5, 2026 -- these are set independently per Anthropic's own docs). Context window (200K), max output (32K), and image+text modality on the Bedrock model card also match the catalog facts.
